title: Transolver: A Fast Transformer Solver for PDEs on General Geometries
layout_note: Left third: a standard pre-norm block, dashed zoom lines from its attention box into a small block diagram of that attention; a vertical dashed rule; right two-thirds: the same attention drawn again with the data — an input field slab fanned into a staircase of weighted field slabs, pooled into token cubes, mixed, broadcast back and merged into an output field slab.
grouping: The layer is a dashed rounded container read bottom-to-top; its zoom is a solid black rounded panel with stacked offset frames behind for the heads. The right half has no container; a two-entry legend at its top-left explains the token cube and the green arrow. Colour families: pale green for LayerNorm, pale blue for feed-forward and the slice/deslice boxes, pale pink for the proposed attention; dark-red text for the token-attention step in both the block diagram and the data drawing; brown curved arrows for slice weights; navy lines for slicing and de-slicing; green arrows for aggregate and broadcast.
shapes_depth: Left: flat rounded rectangles with thin outlines and bold sans labels, circled-plus residual nodes. Right: 3-D slabs (thick plates seen in perspective) whose front faces carry the field on the mesh as colormapped contours (purple for input and output, yellow-green for the weighted slices, blue gradients for broadcast copies); tokens are small shaded 3-D cubes in blue tints joined by a web of thin pale-red lines. Tensor sizes (N x C, M x C, M x (N x C)) sit in sans text under the slabs and cubes; step names (Slice, DeSlice, Slice Weights) are bold italic on the canvas.
proposed_highlight: The proposed attention is the only pink box in the standard block and is expanded twice, first as a block diagram, then as a data drawing; the token-attention step is in dark-red text in both, which ties the two expansions together.
lesson: Explain the new operator twice side by side — a small block diagram zoomed from its box, then the same steps drawn on the physical field itself (field slab split into weighted copies, pooled into a few token cubes, broadcast back) — and give the shared step the same text colour in both.
notes: Venue from the PDF footer ('Proceedings of the 41st International Conference on Machine Learning'; venue_source: pdf). The field faces are embedded images recorded by refs crop and left out of the palette.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
